title: Buddy rebuild — re-test the three fixes

steps.path: The size button in the panel beside the buddy (two diagonal arrows)
steps.headline: Press the size button a few times: does the chat now shrink back as well as grow?
steps.changed: The window system was refusing to make the chat smaller again after it had grown; it is now told the new size limits first. Checked in the test window: small, large, small, large.
steps.notice: Each press switches size; the buddy and chat stay together.

steps.path: Leave him until he dozes off (about four minutes), then point at him or press him
steps.headline: Once he has dozed off, does pointing at him or pressing him wake him up?
steps.changed: Before, only a change in a session's status woke him, so touching a sleeping buddy did nothing. Now pointing at him or pressing him wakes him and restarts his quiet clock.
steps.notice: He wakes the moment you touch him, and does not drop straight back to sleep.

steps.path: The arrow at the right of the buddy's session strip, then New session and its folder picker
steps.headline: Do the menus fit the window now: names lined up under All sessions, the folder list inside the window, the menu following the size button?
steps.changed: Session names and their folder line now start where "All sessions" does; the folder list is never wider than the window and opens upward when there is no room below; the menu's height follows the window; Launch in new window and Manage projects are hidden in the buddy, where they did nothing.
steps.notice: No menu hangs off an edge, and nothing in them is a dead end.
